procedures.title: §8-4: Smart refrigerator WiFi service tests
procedures.purpose: WiFi link and antenna service tests

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the appliance or disconnect power before resistance checks and board access. Live voltage steps require controls off and safe access. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Enter refrigerator service mode
steps.body: Hold Recommended + Drawer buttons simultaneously 5 seconds (chime). Use Icemaker2 = Enter; Up/Down navigate; Fast Cool = Back.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Hold Recommended + Drawer buttons simultaneously 5 seconds (chime). Use Icemaker2 = Enter; Up/Down navigate; Fast Cool = Back.

steps.title: Test 106 — WiFi link self-test
steps.body: Hold Up arrow to advance to WiFi Service Test 106. Display shows 00 while testing, then 01/02/03 result.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Hold Up arrow to advance to WiFi Service Test 106. Display shows 00 while testing, then 01/02/03 result.

steps.title: Link test result code
steps.body: 01 = cannot link AP/WISE; 02 = AP OK but not WISE; 03 = connected to AP and WISE.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 01 = cannot link AP/WISE; 02 = AP OK but not WISE; 03 = connected to AP and WISE.

steps.title: Tests 108–109 antenna signal
steps.body: Navigate to tests 108 and 109. Record antenna 1 and 2 signal strength (0–100%).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Navigate to tests 108 and 109. Record antenna 1 and 2 signal strength (0–100%).

steps.title: Check 12.7 VDC WiFi supply
steps.body: WiFi board fed from Orion P16-1 to WiFi J3-1. Verify board seating and antenna coupler under right hinge cover.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WiFi board fed from Orion P16-1 to WiFi J3-1. Verify board seating and antenna coupler under right hinge cover.

steps.body: Unplug the appliance or disconnect power before resistance checks and board access. Live voltage steps require controls off and safe access. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Use laundry 3-button × 3 entry (washer §5-5 / dryer §6-5) or dishwasher 1-2-3 cycle entry as applicable.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use laundry 3-button × 3 entry (washer §5-5 / dryer §6-5) or dishwasher 1-2-3 cycle entry as applicable.

steps.title: Open Software Version Display
steps.body: Laundry: hold 2nd button used for diagnostic entry 5 seconds. Display cycles UI, ACU, WiFi (n), and PMM (p) revision codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Laundry: hold 2nd button used for diagnostic entry 5 seconds. Display cycles UI, ACU, WiFi (n), and PMM (p) revision codes.

steps.title: WiFi software version (n label)
steps.body: Does display show WiFi revision (n major.minor.test) — not n--?
steps.sourceExcerpt: n-- means UI and WiFi module are not communicating.

steps.title: All versions show -- ?
steps.body: If every software version is --, UI or harness fault; F6E2 should also be present.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Only WiFi n-- — harness or WiFi module.

steps.sourceExcerpt: If every software version is --, UI or harness fault; F6E2 should also be present.

steps.title: Inspect WiFi harness
steps.body: Unplug power. Verify WiFi module connector and WIDE/WIN harness. Restore power and retest version display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug power. Verify WiFi module connector and WIDE/WIN harness. Restore power and retest version display.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the appliance or disconnect power before resistance checks and board access. Live voltage steps require controls off and safe access. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Access PM board
steps.body: Unplug appliance. Access Power Management board under console (washer/dryer). Confirm J4 CT, J1 AC sense, and J2/J3 WIDE/WIN seated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug appliance. Access Power Management board under console (washer/dryer). Confirm J4 CT, J1 AC sense, and J2/J3 WIDE/WIN seated.

steps.title: CT1 resistance (J4 pins 1 & 2)
steps.body: Remove J4. Measure CT1 across pins 1 & 2 — 135 Ω ±5%.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove J4. Measure CT1 across pins 1 & 2 — 135 Ω ±5%.

steps.title: Appliance uses L2 (CT2)?
steps.body: Electric dryers use two CTs at terminal block. Gas dryer and smart washer typically CT1 only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electric dryers use two CTs at terminal block. Gas dryer and smart washer typically CT1 only.

steps.title: CT2 resistance (J4 pins 3 & 4)
steps.body: Measure CT2 across pins 3 & 4 — 135 Ω ±5%.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure CT2 across pins 3 & 4 — 135 Ω ±5%.

steps.title: Reconnect J4 — restore power
steps.body: Reconnect J4. Restore power for live PM board supply check.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J4. Restore power for live PM board supply check.

steps.title: PM board +5 VDC (J2-1 to J2-3)
steps.body: Live DC check at J2 pins 1 & 3 (J3 interchangeable). Expect 5 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Live DC check at J2 pins 1 & 3 (J3 interchangeable). Expect 5 VDC.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the appliance or disconnect power before resistance checks and board access. Live voltage steps require controls off and safe access. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Customer connectivity attempt
steps.body: Have customer run Whirlpool app or WPS connect. After process, is console WiFi icon steady ON?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: WiFi icon off — appliance-side fault path.

steps.sourceExcerpt: After connectivity process, does appliance connect? WiFi icon on steady.

steps.title: Access WiFi module
steps.body: Unplug appliance. Remove console/control to expose WiFi module. Verify J4 WIDE/WIN and antenna connectors fully seated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug appliance. Remove console/control to expose WiFi module. Verify J4 WIDE/WIN and antenna connectors fully seated.

steps.title: Restore power — allow initialize
steps.body: Plug in appliance. Allow ~1 minute for boards to initialize before live checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in appliance. Allow ~1 minute for boards to initialize before live checks.

steps.title: WiFi module +5 VDC (J4-1 to J4-6)
steps.body: Set meter to DC. Red to J4-1, black to J4-6. Expect ~5 VDC (may read higher per tech sheet).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Set meter to DC. Red to J4-1, black to J4-6. Expect ~5 VDC (may read higher per tech sheet).

steps.title: WiFi status LED during connect
steps.body: Press CONNECT and observe module LED window. Green fast blink (10 Hz) during connect = module good. Off/amber only after connect attempt = replace module after harness check.

branches.label: Green fast blink or steady green

steps.sourceExcerpt: Green fast blinking = trying to connect; green on = connected to router.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: WiFi icon off — appliance-side fault path.

branches.label: Green fast blink or steady green
